book.name: Emi iHibru
book.title: Afɛ ngwi a lɔ kɛmbi ama onoyɛyɛ Emi iHibru

content: Adɔ okwookwo ikye ogbɛwɛbyi
Nghanɛ, i yɛɛ kyɛmɛ ngwi eyi ka gbɛwɛbyi ungwɔ ama ngwi eyi teyi fwo na saan, ikye ni eyi wa boofɛ ba mani.
Lubana ni esɔ ngwi engyesɔ gbɔ na li otsitsi, ni ali ola ofaafa yi adɔ onghaangha li tu adɔ okwookwo mgban yɛyɛ wali,
eyi ka nyɛ ole kini eyi fwa owatɔ-watɔ ogbagbadzidzi ngwi Otsɛ woolan, ngwi ama nfwo kyɔ obwɛndɛ nya eyi nɛ?
Imgbasho kpaa kyɔ obwɛndɛ mi ele, mi okyɔ ambɛ ungwɔ ama okwulewo ita idzidza-dzidza, O di gha inggisɛ umba onodzi osaan dafi O mina mani.
IYesu yɛɛ dafi emi ongwunɔn mani
Imgbasho kye engyesɔ dzɛkɛ gbɛɛ nu ma wa kye ɛsɛ nkyiyayi ngwi eyi le gbɔdzan nɛ teyi ba.
Kpaa imbe dzɛma ngwi inggisɛ oka nu obwɛndɛ gbɛɛ, <<Inggisɛ li ekyɛ se ngwi abu kyon wuuta nghaa, naadi ongwɛ inggisɛ ma li ekyɛ se ngwi abu gbekabyin nghaa?
Abu yilen esɛ gwee ngha engyesɔ; abu tukwun okpapyi mgbi okwɔkwɔ yi mmwɛ
di non li ikye mi alungwɔ duu.>> Ngwi Imgbasho kyɔ nghanɛ, alungwɔ duu dubɔn. Nghaduukpaa onɛnɛ li ungwɔ duu dubɔn waba.
Kpaa eyi di iYesu ngwu a non yɛsɛ gwee ngha engyesɔ na, onɛnɛ a tukwun okpapyi okwɔkwɔ oshewo bɛyi mmwɛ ikyekyɛ o gbiisɔ ikwongye, ikye no kwikwu ikye ali inggisɛ duu mi elela mgbi Imgbasho.
Imgbasho ongwu alungwɔ duu byito abɔn na, di gbɛɛ i gbuo ni ongye onagbɛ na yɛɛ saan mi isɔ ogyeegye se no wa gbe emi ongwan kaka okwɔkwɔ oshewo.
Ongwu nnu inggisɛ yɛɛ saan na bɛyi ama n yɛɛ saan duu li etɔ onyi. Nghanɛ ayiwi yama kwu iYesu okwu ma di emi ongwunɔn ba du.
O gbɔgbɛɛ, <<N ka kwu iyi abu nya emi ongwunani; n ka shashi otsɛ iyi abu mi inai okwakye mgbi emidabu.>>
O di gbɛɛ, <<N ka kye oyɛyɛ onuunu mgbi ani byi mbon.>> O di kiyayi gbɛɛ, <<Ani dzɛna yi ɛngbɛ ama Imgbasho gbe nu ani duu.>>
Ngwi engwɛ dzɛ mi mmbwɛ yi eyi nɛ, ongwu kpaa wa yɛɛ inggisɛ owamyɛ adzi no wa kyi dzili ongye nsulu mfye mgbi ikwongye nani, li owapɛ olodu waali
di dulu ama imio ikwongye kwu ma ofyɛɛ mi oshishe mgbi ama duu ntona watɔ mani.
Lubana otsitsi-otsitsi yɔ, li engyesɔ ngwu o ya ma abɔ ba kpaa li etɔ mgbi Abrahan.

Mi itɔdzɛ nɛ i yɛɛ kyɛmɛ-kyɛmɛ no yɛɛ dafi emi ongwunɔn mi ali itɔ ofɛ duu, ikyegbɛɛ no yɛɛ inggisɛ ofifɛ okwukwo odi elela byi otsitsi mi idɔ mgban okyɔ Imgbasho ele, di kyi kyelu ali ibwubwe mgbi inggisɛ.
Ikyegbɛɛ ongwu abuon kpaa gbiisɔ mi onɔ ngwi a gyilan nɛ, o ka yagba tobyi ama nkaka igyila ntonɛni.
